question: How many doctors (MBBS+) are practicing in India?
idealClarificationQuestions: Allopathic only (excludes AYUSH)? Allopathic; flag AYUSH separately.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Cumulative MBBS produced × active practitioner share.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: MBBS seats annually in India: ~1.06 lakh (post 2024 increases).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, active in India (not migrated, retired, deceased): ~75% = ~1.3M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus AYUSH (BAMS, BHMS, BUMS) registered: ~800K, of which active ~600K.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total allopathic active: ~1.3M; combined with AYUSH: ~1.9M.
